notes.title: Scoring Update
notes.content: [list][*][p]Adjusted existing scoring system:[/p][list][*][p]New completed levels are counted into the scoring as +10[/p][/*][*][p]New completed levels are treated as a multiplier (multiplying the calculated score by n_levels_complete)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Update End Game UI:[/p][list][*][p]Added arrows and plusses to the stat values that needed it[/p][/*][*][p]Update Time to not display as a negative value[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Not changed" text to Rank if the rank did not change on the leaderboards[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
